items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Tell me about working with Pearl Bailey,' but the interviewee (Gil Evans) does not respond to this specific question in the provided transcript, instead continuing to discuss Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: I'm going to ask him some time, how come?
Tell me about working with Pearl Bailey.

When you asked me about Benny Goodman remember, I didn't really work for Benny Goodman much. I wrote just a couple of arrangements for him at certain times. Not, not in his hey day. After all in his hey day he had Jimmy Mundy and Fletcher Henderson, so he was okay. (VOICE FADES OUT).
